settings.hero_desc: A miniature company map model of an MNC companies of all their property location, reproduced to scale with buildings, roads, landscaping and branding, presented in a clear case on a branded base. A memorable VIP gift or commemorative centrepiece for institutions and organisations.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your campus/area layout, branding, labels and base plaque
settings.s1_body: This miniature map turns an entire real estate of company into a presentation-quality keepsake - buildings, roads, water and greenery laid out to scale, labelled and branded, then sealed under a clear case on a finished base. It makes a meaningful VIP gift, donor recognition piece or institutional centrepiece that celebrates a place and the people behind it.
settings.case_heading: A Gift That Tells a Story
settings.case_body: Comissioned for BOSCO Company as a VIP Gift for their Chairman. This miniature map celebrated all the properties of BOSCO located in different parts of the world - presented to BOSCO Chairman of honour as a keepsake that captured the whole site in one branded, display-ready piece.
settings.case_quote: Our Chairman loved it. You can see his expression in this video. Thank you once again for your patience and support.
settings.prov_p: A miniature of a place people care about carries real meaning - it celebrates a story, a milestone and a community in a way no generic gift can.
